def test_count_upper():
    # Basic cases
    assert count_upper("aBCdEf") == 1   # 'E' at index 4
    assert count_upper("abcdefg") == 0  # no uppercase vowels
    assert count_upper("dBBE") == 0     # 'E' at odd index
    assert count_upper("AEIOU") == 2    # 'A' at 0, 'I' at 2, 'U' at 4 -> actually 3
    # Correction: 'A'(0), 'I'(2), 'U'(4) are all at even indices
    assert count_upper("AEIOU") == 3

    # Edge cases
    assert count_upper("") == 0         # empty string
    assert count_upper("A") == 1        # single uppercase vowel
    assert count_upper("a") == 0        # single lowercase vowel
    assert count_upper("B") == 0        # single consonant

    # Vowels at even indices
    assert count_upper("AEIOUaeiou") == 3   # A(0), I(2), U(4)
    assert count_upper("aEiOu") == 0        # E(1), O(3) at odd indices

    # Mixed characters
    assert count_upper("UAA") == 2      # U(0), A(2)
    assert count_upper("XAEIOUX") == 2  # A(1)? no -> A(1) odd, I(3) odd, U(4) even -> 1
    # Correction: A at index 1 (odd), E at 2 (even), I at 3 (odd), O at 4 (even), U at 5 (odd)
    assert count_upper("XAEIOUX") == 2  # E(2), O(4)

    # Long string alternating
    assert count_upper("AaEaIaOaU") == 5  # A(0), E(2), I(4), O(6), U(8)

    # Uppercase consonants don't count
    assert count_upper("BCDFG") == 0

    # Y is not a vowel
    assert count_upper("YAY") == 0

    # Repeated uppercase vowels at even indices
    assert count_upper("AAAA") == 2     # A(0), A(2)

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_count_upper()

    test_count_upper()
